findings.issue: 国 (くに) is glossed as 'parents' — flatly wrong word; 国 means 'country' (looks like a back-translation of the unaccented pt gloss 'pais'). Teaches a false meaning for a basic N5 noun.
Missing accent turns 'país' (country) into 'pais' (parents) — sense-changing in a learner-facing gloss of 国.

pt gloss of よい is 'bem' plus a parenthetical about よくない, a form that does not occur in this sentence (copy-paste from another context). Here よい is the plain affirmative adjective 'bom' (predicate of どんなによいだろう).
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)

findings.issue: 自分一人で生きられる人はいない means 'no one can live alone / by themselves' (self-sufficiency). 'live for himself' reads as 'for his own sake', a different claim; lit_en and pt render it correctly, so en is the outlier.
findings.current: No man can live for himself.
findings.suggested: No one can live all by themselves.

findings.issue: Sub-tokens もう and 一度 (all-null) are misplaced at the start of the token list, but the sentence begins with 失礼ですが; the combined token もう一度 correctly appears after 、. Token order no longer mirrors the sentence (cf. sent:tatoeba-149720 where null sub-tokens sit adjacent to their combined token).
findings.current: tokens: もう, 一度, 失礼, です, が, 、, もう一度, おっしゃっ, て, 下さい, 。
findings.suggested: Move the null もう / 一度 sub-tokens to sit adjacent to もう一度 (after 、) so token order mirrors the sentence

findings.issue: Multiple stripped accents: 'O tema e' and 'O ponto central e' should use 'é'; 'pais' should be 'país' in all three occurrences.
findings.current: O tema e 社会の習慣は...; O ponto central e 国によって ('dependendo do pais / conforme o pais')... de acordo com o pais.
findings.suggested: O tema é...; O ponto central é...; 'dependendo do país / conforme o país'; ...de acordo com o país.

findings.current: Os costumes da sociedade, dependendo do pais, diferem.
findings.suggested: Os costumes da sociedade, dependendo do país, diferem.

findings.current: criterio/causa (base da expressão によって)
findings.suggested: critério/causa (base da expressão によって)

findings.issue: でしょうか is rendered as a confirmation tag 'right?', but it is a softening conjecture ('I wonder if...'), as the expl itself states; the tag-question rendering misrepresents its function.
findings.current: The dictionary, couldn't [I] have you lend it, right? (= could you lend me the dictionary?)
findings.suggested: The dictionary, couldn't [I] have you lend it, I wonder? (= could you lend me the dictionary?)

findings.issue: でしょうか rendered as 'não é mesmo?' (confirmation-seeking tag), but it is a softening conjecture ('será que...?'), as the pt translation and expl correctly treat it.
findings.current: Dicionário, emprestar-e [eu] não poderia receber, não é mesmo? (= não daria para você me emprestar o dicionário?)
findings.suggested: Dicionário, será que emprestar-e [eu] não poderia receber? (= não daria para você me emprestar o dicionário?)
